COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMMUNITY SERVICE LEARNING
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. Which statement about Nurturing Empathy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Nurturing Empathy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Nurturing Empathy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Nurturing Empathy as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Nurturing Empathy.

4. Which statement about Civic Dialogue is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Civic Dialogue with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Civic Dialogue.
   C. Treat Civic Dialogue as rumours only.
   D. Say Civic Dialogue never happens in Kenya.

   D. Explain symbols used on a map
